collectionunit.notes: A surface monolith of the vegetation was collected to acquire sufficient material for plant macrofossil analysis. A companion Russian peat core was collected, with its top set at the water surface, which was 12 cm below the bog surface. The data presented herein represent a composite core, with the upper 12 cm from the monolith and the lower 186.5 cm from the Russian peat core, for a total composite core length of 198.5 cm.

site.sitedescription: Bog located in Monongahela National Forest. Surrounding vegetation: Sphagnum-dominated carpet with some Rhododendron and blueberry on higher hummocks with Polytrichum; Vaccinium oxycoccos, Eriophorum (cotton grass), Nepenthes (pitcher plant). Surrounding forest includes Picea, Tsuga, Quercus, Acer, Betula, Ostrya/Carpinus, Ilex.
